mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) indicates inflationary pressures, which typically leads to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market, which is typically associated with economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which is a positive signal for corporate earnings and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side of the economy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, which is typically associated with economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with an increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) suggests accommodative monetary policy in the face of inflation, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases by >0.25% and CPIAUCSL increases by >0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) indicates strong demand in the housing market, which is a positive signal for economic growth and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Real GDP (GDPC1) signals a weakening economy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.
